title: Rethinking Multilingual Continual Pretraining: Data Mixing for Adapting LLMs Across Languages and Resources
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical aspects of continual pretraining (CPT) for Large Language Models across various languages and resource levels. Its evaluation and benchmarking are centered on language classification (SIB-200) and machine translation (FLORES-200), not on religion, faith, ethics, or moral reasoning.
